response.sql: WITH units AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), mix_baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units) SELECT AVG(u.ownership) AS average_ownership, AVG(u.ownership / NULLIF(m.baseline, 0)) AS average_relative_to_mix, AVG(u.ownership - o.baseline) AS average_excess_ownership FROM units AS u JOIN mix_baselines AS m ON m.ordertypedist = u.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall_baseline AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.baseline;
